title: Directional Attention Guidance for Diffusion Models via Sparse Hopfield Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2603.02531v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) improves sample quality in diffusion models, but its dual-pass inference and null-condition training limit its use in few-step regimes. Attention-space guidance is a single-pass alternative, yet why sparse-versus-dense attention guidance works remains elusive. We analyze attention extrapolation through Modern Hopfield dynamics and establish two directional properties of the sparse-dense discrepancy under shared conditioning that identify it as an acceleration direction toward the dominant stored pattern. Building on this, we propose Directional Attention Guidance (DAG), a training-free, single-pass rule that amplifies only the component of the discrepancy aligned with the retrieval direction; stability follows from a weak contraction property, and an analysis inside real cross-attention layers shows that this alignment is observed throughout sampling. DAG generalizes across UNet and MMDiT backbone

translated_title: 基于稀疏霍普菲尔德检索的扩散模型方向性注意力引导
translated_abstract: 无分类器引导在扩散模型中提升了样本质量，但其双通道推理和空条件训练限制了它在少步生成场景中的应用。注意力空间引导是一种单通道替代方案，然而稀疏与稠密注意力引导为何有效仍不明确。我们通过现代霍普菲尔德动力学分析注意力外推，并在共享条件下建立了稀疏-稠密差异的两个方向性性质，将其识别为指向主导存储模式的加速方向。基于此，我们提出了方向性注意力引导，这是一种无需训练、单通道的规则，仅放大与检索方向对齐的差异分量；稳定性源于弱收缩性质，并且在真实交叉注意力层内部的分析表明，这种对齐在整个采样过程中均可观察到。DAG可泛化应用于UNet和MMDiT骨干网络。
tldr: 该论文提出方向性注意力引导，一种基于现代霍普菲尔德动力学分析、无需训练的单通道引导方法，通过仅放大稀疏-稠密注意力差异中与检索方向对齐的分量，在少步扩散模型采样中有效替代无分类器引导。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Directional Attention Guidance (DAG), a training-free, single-pass method grounded in Modern Hopfield dynamics that amplifies only the retrieval-aligned component of the sparse-dense attention discrepancy, serving as an effective alternative to classifier-free guidance in few-step diffusion sampling.
